description: This file contains functions for parsing and rendering Markdown content, including handling headers, code blocks, notes, and nested lists. It exports functions for parsing Markdown text into a node tree, rendering nodes back to Markdown, cloning nodes, visiting nodes, and filtering nodes by language.

methods.name: flattenWrappedLines
methods.description: Flattens wrapped lines in Markdown content, handling code blocks and special syntax.

methods.name: buildTree
methods.description: Builds a hierarchical Markdown node tree from lines of Markdown text.

methods.name: parseCodeBlockMetadata
methods.description: Parses metadata from code block first lines, extracting language, title, and highlight info.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Main function to parse Markdown content into a node tree.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders a list of Markdown nodes back into Markdown text.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of a Markdown node.

methods.name: visitAll
methods.description: Visits all nodes in a list, applying a visitor function.

methods.name: visit
methods.description: Recursively visits a node and its children, applying a visitor function.

methods.name: filterNodesForLanguage
methods.description: Filters nodes to include only those matching a specified language in 'langs:' list.

methods.name: wrapText
methods.description: Wraps text to a maximum column width, optionally flattening line breaks.
